output.assessment: The evidence establishes that rooftop vehicle stunts in Mumbai require a Structural Stability Certificate from a BMC-licensed structural engineer under Section 353B of the MMC Act 1888, with load calculations adhering to IS 875. Filming permissions and temporary structures (like ramps) are governed by the BMC Film Shooting Policy (2019) via the Single Window System. However, specific municipal guidelines explicitly detailing vehicle stunts on rooftops are not codified and must be approved on a case-by-case basis with NOCs from the Mumbai Police and Chief Fire Officer (CFO).

evidence.claim: Roof structural safety and design loads in India are governed by IS 875 (covering dead, imposed, wind, and snow loads), requiring a structural stability certificate issued by a qualified structural engineer.
evidence.production_implication: The production must hire a structural engineer to calculate the rooftop's load capacity against IS 875 standards to ensure it can support the motorcycle, ramps, and crew (serving req_sc_42_2).

evidence.claim: Under Section 353B of the MMC Act 1888, structural audits and stability inspections of buildings in Mumbai must be conducted by a qualified Structural Engineer registered with the Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (MCGM/BMC).
evidence.production_implication: The production must obtain a Structural Stability Certificate from a BMC-registered structural engineer for the selected rooftops before executing any stunts (serving req_sc_42_2).

evidence.claim: The BMC Film Shooting Policy (No. SL/29575/Advt. dated 01.03.2019) regulates shooting permissions and the erection of temporary/semi-permanent structures within MCGM Ward Jurisdiction via the State Single Window System.
evidence.production_implication: The production must apply for filming permissions and temporary structure erection (ramps) through the BMC Single Window System (serving req_sc_42_1 and req_sc_42_2).

evidence.claim: Under Mumbai's Development Control and Promotion Regulations (DCPR 2034), even minor or temporary modifications are subject to structural stability certification from a Licensed Structural Engineer.
evidence.production_implication: Any reinforcement or temporary modifications made to the adjoining rooftops must be certified by a licensed structural engineer to comply with DCPR 2034 (serving req_sc_42_2).

evidence.claim: Industry-wide safety standards require stunt coordinators to conduct risk assessments, inspect specialized equipment, and coordinate safety measures for stunt sequences.
evidence.production_implication: A dedicated stunt coordinator must oversee the rooftop setup, coordinate with the high-angle rescue team, and ensure fall-arrest rigging is inspected (serving req_sc_42_12).
